# Synthetic data

**Everything here is fake.** People, employers, PO numbers and notes are all generated by `tools/generate_synthetic_data.py` (seed `20261031`). Nothing comes from ERI's systems. Every row has `synthetic=TRUE`.

Regenerate: `pip install faker && python3 tools/generate_synthetic_data.py`

## PRD 02 / 03: job seekers and postings

| File | Rows | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `job_seekers.csv` | 40 | Job seeker profiles: Milwaukee neighborhood, interests, skills, accommodations, desired hours, transportation, benefits type, DVR/IRIS program, IPE goal |
| `job_postings.csv` | 60 | Fictional Milwaukee employers: title, category, hours, wage, insurance, shift, bus access, description (some include barrier phrases for PRD 03) |

## PRD 01: DVR billing (`dvr/`)

| File | Rows | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fee_schedule.csv` | 7 | Supported Employment services and rates from the WI DVR fee structure (Jul 2026 to Jun 2028) |
| `authorizations.csv` | ~118 | DVR purchase orders: which service was authorized for which client, and when |
| `service_notes.csv` | ~314 | Case notes: date, service, note text, hire details, report submitted date |
| `invoices.csv` | ~242 | What ERI billed: PO, service, month number, amount |

The billing data contains **planted problems** for teams to find: missed months, unbilled hires, underbilled preferred outcomes, and late reports. It also has a **trap**: some months are correctly unbilled because the client wasn't employed. Judges hold the answer key, which is not in the repo.

## PRD 01: Ticket to Work (`ticket/`) and county (`county/`): SIMPLIFIED rules
| File | What |
| --- | --- |
| `ticket/tickets.csv` | 15 fake SSDI Ticket holders assigned to ERI PLUS |
| `ticket/monthly_earnings.csv` | Gross earnings per month, and whether a pay stub is on file |
| `ticket/payment_requests.csv` | Payments ERI requested from SSA |
| `county/authorizations.csv` | Units (15-min) authorized per client per month |
| `county/units_delivered.csv` | Units actually delivered |
| `county/claims.csv` | Units claimed, at a FAKE $25/unit |

Simplified Ticket rules (2026): Phase 1 milestone 1 = first month ≥ $1,210 (pays $1,904); milestone 2 = 3rd such month ($1,904); after that, Phase 2 = each month > $1,690 SGA ($571). No pay stub = can't claim yet. Real rules: `wiki/knowledge/benefits/ticket-to-work.md`.

Planted: unclaimed Ticket payments, missing pay stubs, county under-claims, and county **over-claims** (a risk to flag, never money to collect).

### Join keys
`client_id` links authorizations, notes and invoices. `po_number` links authorizations and invoices. `service_code` links to `fee_schedule.csv`.
